List the bowlers (including their ID, first name, and last name), match number, game number, handicap score, tournament date, and location for only those bowlers who have won games with a handicap score of 190 or less at all three venues: Thunderbird Lanes, Totem Lanes, and Bolero Lanes. Only include the specific game records where they won with a handicap score of 190 or less at these three locations.

content.text: I will first identify the bowlers who have won games with a handicap score of 190 or less at all three specified venues: 'Thunderbird Lanes', 'Totem Lanes', and 'Bolero Lanes'. To do this, I will join the `Bowler_Scores`, `Tourney_Matches`, and `Tournaments` tables, filtering for winning games with the specified handicap score and locations. Then, I will group by bowler and count the distinct locations to find those who have won at all three.

args.sql:
SELECT
  b.BowlerID,
  b.BowlerFirstName,
  b.BowlerLastName,
  bs.MatchID,
  bs.GameNumber,
  bs.HandiCapScore,
  t.TourneyDate,
  t.TourneyLocation
FROM Bowlers AS b
JOIN Bowler_Scores AS bs
  ON b.BowlerID = bs.BowlerID
JOIN Tourney_Matches AS tm
  ON bs.MatchID = tm.MatchID
JOIN Tournaments AS t
  ON tm.TourneyID = t.TourneyID
WHERE
  bs.WonGame = 1 AND bs.HandiCapScore <= 190 AND t.TourneyLocation IN ('Thunderbird Lanes', 'Totem Lanes', 'Bolero Lanes') AND b.BowlerID IN (
    SELECT
      bs.BowlerID
    FROM Bowler_Scores AS bs
    JOIN Tourney_Matches AS tm
      ON bs.MatchID = tm.MatchID
    JOIN Tournaments AS t
      ON tm.TourneyID = t.TourneyID
    WHERE
      bs.WonGame = 1 AND bs.HandiCapScore <= 190 AND t.TourneyLocation IN ('Thunderbird Lanes', 'Totem Lanes', 'Bolero Lanes')
    GROUP BY
      bs.BowlerID
    HAVING
      COUNT(DISTINCT t.TourneyLocation) = 3
  )
